name: Calicasas (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over green with a white isosceles triangle from the hoist to the middle of the fly, over which lies a blue triangle from the hoist to the centre.
history: Calicasas adopted its arms and flag officially on 4 January 2006; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, formed of a white isosceles triangle with its vertices at the ends of the hoist and the midpoint of the fly, with a smaller triangle superimposed.

features.role: isosceles triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the middle of the fly
triangle with its base along the hoist and its apex at the centre
